Driving a 3 mm long modulator at 1 MHz, we measure a half-wave voltage of Vπ = 1.50 V, corresponding to a voltage-length product of VπL = 450 mV·cm for an electrode gap of 3 µm [Fig. 4(a)].
No 3 dB roll-off is observed within the measurement range, demonstrating an electro-optic bandwidth exceeding 50 GHz, limited by the available RF source.
